would take the initiative toward us to give us Your Son, to take on the penalty that
we deserve, that we should have paid?
Who are we that you would choose to share with us your very self and create in us your very
life?
Lord, we pray that you would do that even more.
We're overwhelmed by your love.
We're humbled by it.
Allow us, by Your grace and through the power of Your Spirit, to live more and more as those
who have been loved by Jesus Christ.
Lord, allow us to encourage one another in this.
Cause us to remember who we are now in You.
And then fill us with thanksgiving for the way in which You answer this prayer.
And we ask this in Christ's name, Amen.
